summary.text: Jennifer Jenkins is the Democratic nominee for Florida's 8th Congressional District. A speech-language pathologist and former Brevard Public Schools board member, she briefly sought the 2026 U.S. Senate special election before running for this House seat. In her candidate survey she describes a career in public education and campaigns on housing affordability, including homeowners insurance costs.

paragraphs.text: Jenkins describes herself as the daughter of a corrections officer and a mother who became disabled when Jenkins was young, and says she was raised in a working-class family. She earned a bachelor's degree from Florida Atlantic University in 2009 and a graduate degree from the University of Central Florida in 2014.
She worked as a speech-language pathologist and says she built her career in public education, working with children and families, particularly students with disabilities and developmental needs.
In 2020, Jenkins was elected to the Brevard Public Schools school board, District 3, defeating incumbent Tina Descovich. She served from November 2020 to November 2024 and did not seek re-election.
She also filed to run in the 2026 U.S. Senate special election in Florida before running for this U.S. House seat; she did not appear on the special Democratic primary ballot.
Jenkins says her husband is a public school teacher and their daughter attends Brevard Public Schools.
